title: Lost in the poison fog
summary: A huge creature in the poison fog scatters the righteous disciples. Xiao Yicai saves a fellow disciple from the swamp's beasts and they push on to find the others. In the fog Gui Li is attacked by a Qingyun swordswoman; after the fight she spares him and warns that next time they meet they will be enemies, and Gui Li asks Xiao Hui why she did not kill him. Fa Xiang, alone, meets Jin Ping'er, who flirts with him; he attacks her as a demoness and she escapes. Zeng Shushu and Lin Jingyu are caught by a carnivorous bladderwort flower, which Zeng Shushu knows how to handle, and Fa Xiang joins them so the three travel on together.

flags: Short subtitle file (about 150 lines); much of the episode is action without dialogue.

466-645 s: Gui Li's opponent is never named. He thinks her technique is Qingyun's; she warns they'll be enemies next time; at 639 s he says Xiao Hui knew her too. Read as Lu Xueqi (EP33 has her ask him why he didn't kill her).

718-727 s: an inner monologue about the Sinister Bead entering a person's mind, held back by Buddhist and Taoist teaching and 'the Black Fire Mirror'. The speaker is unclear, and so is whether 'Black Fire Mirror' means the Mystic Fire Mirror.
425.6 s: the disciple thanking Xiao Yicai is not named.
171.9 s and 190.3 s ('Muda!') are fragments; 904 s 'Utricularia' = bladderwort.
